headline: On recurring same-repo workflows (2 families x 10 variants, live Haiku 4.5), a procedure card learned from earlier sessions of the family cuts $/task by 18.8% [11.6, 25.8] and calls by 16% with pass rate unchanged (20/24 vs 19/24), vs 8.8% for today's Adage (which here is U11); but learning steps rather than compounds: nearly all of the value is available after the first session of the family.
metric_name: live billed $ per session, arm/control - 1, paired by (variant, repeat), 90% bootstrap clustered by variant

held_out.n: 24 pairs per contrast, 12 held-out variants (6 per family), 2 repeats; CIs under-cover with 12 clusters (read as ~80%)

learning_curve.reading: step, not compounding: flat from n=1 offline; live n=1 card -15.3% [-30.9, +0.4] vs n=4 card -22.9% on the same 6 marshmallow variants

leave_one_repo_out: not applicable: the card is per repository and family by construction; two families on two repositories agree in sign and size (click -16.3%, marshmallow -22.9%). Cross-family transfer was not tested.

vs_baseline.live_adage_arm: -8.8% $ [-14.6, -1.9], -4.4 calls: consistent with the U11 replay (+7.6% $, +3.6 calls)
vs_baseline.repobench_baseline: U11 +1.9% $ post-hoc / +3.9% pre-emptive on one-off bug fixes

hard_coded_parts: benchmark families, prompts, hidden checks, gold patches (hand-written, not part of the learner)

procedure.py: edit-tool set (Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit); shell normalisation (drop leading cd, pipes, redirections, heredoc bodies; 6 tokens); >= half-of-sessions threshold; clip lengths; the card's fixed headings
analyze.py instrument only: role taxonomy (search/read/vcs command lists), 0.6 template similarity, oracle/realistic set definitions
family membership given, not detected (no trigger measured)

ceiling.note: card live captures ~26% of the perfect-procedure oracle; the rest is orientation reads (unchanged by the card) and repeated test runs; hook-executing template edits adds only ~4 points

build_recommendation: Workflow families + compiled procedure card: cluster a repo's sessions by prompt similarity (existing intent trigger) and shared edited files; after the first passing session compile a card (frequent files in order, added-line exemplars, working test command, avoid list; commands sandbox-verified) and deliver it at UserPromptSubmit on a family match. Expected -15 to -20% $ on family-matching tasks (overall effect scales with the recurring share of usage), ~600 tokens (~$0.003) per delivery. Keep U11 predictive: worth ~8% on recurring work. Next: measure the family trigger's precision and a hook-delivered card on a third family (~$6).
so_what: Shipped, a learned procedure card is expected to save 18.8% of $ per recurring-family task (90% CI 11.6-25.8, ~80% effective coverage) and 16% of calls with no pass-rate loss, +10.9% of $ beyond today's Adage, available after one prior session of the family and not growing after that; moderate confidence it survives a live A/B (12 variants, 2 researcher-designed families, 1 model, family given); confirm with a third-family micro-slice, hook-delivered, ~$6.
